ciprofloxacin.name: ciprofloxacin
ciprofloxacin.definition: A quinolone that is quinolin-4(1H)-one bearing cyclopropyl, carboxylic acid, fluoro and piperazin-1-yl substituents at positions 1, 3, 6 and 7, respectively.

norfloxacin.name: norfloxacin
norfloxacin.definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid with broad-spectrum antibacterial activity against most gram-negative and gram-positive bacteria. Norfloxacin is bactericidal and its mode of action depends on blocking of bacterial DNA replication by binding itself to an enzyme called DNA gyrase.

ceftolozane.name: ceftolozane
ceftolozane.definition: A fifth-generation cephalosporin antibiotic having (5-amino-4-{[(2-aminoethyl)carbamoyl]amino}-1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-2-ium-2-yl)methyl and

tigecycline.name: tigecycline(1+)
tigecycline.definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of tigecycline; major species at pH 7.3.

aztreonam.name: aztreonam
aztreonam.definition: A synthetic monocyclic β-lactam antibiotic (monobactam), used primarily to treat infections caused by Gram-negative bacteria. It inhibits mucopeptide synthesis in the bacterial cell wall, thereby blocking peptidoglycan crosslinking.

streptomycin.name: streptomycin
streptomycin.definition: A amino cyclitol glycoside that consists of streptidine having a disaccharyl moiety attached at the 4-position. The parent of the streptomycin class

penicillin.name: penicillin
penicillin.definition: Any member of the group of substituted penams containing two methyl substituents at position 2, a carboxylate substituent at position 3 and a carboxamido group at position 6.

penicillins.name: penicillin
penicillins.definition: Any member of the group of substituted penams containing two methyl substituents at position 2, a carboxylate substituent at position 3 and a carboxamido group at position 6.

chloramphenicol.name: chloramphenicol
chloramphenicol.definition: An organochlorine compound that is dichloro-substituted acetamide containing a nitrobenzene ring, an amide bond and two alcohol functions.

gentamicin.name: gentamycin
gentamicin.definition: Any of a group of aminoglycoside antibiotics produced by fermentation of some Micromonospora spp.

imipenem.name: imipenem zwitterion
imipenem.definition: Zwitterionic form of imipenem having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated methaneimidamido group; major species at pH 7.3.

cefotaxime.name: cefotaxime
cefotaxime.definition: A cephalosporin compound having acetoxymethyl and

cefoxitin.name: cefoxitin
cefoxitin.definition: A semisynthetic cephamycin antibiotic which, in addition to the methoxy group at the 7α position, has 2-thienylacetamido and carbamoyloxymethyl side-groups. It is resistant to β-lactamase.

cephalosporin.name: cephalosporin
cephalosporin.definition: A class of β-lactam antibiotics differing from the penicillins in having a 6-membered, rather than a 5-membered, side ring.  Although cephalosporins are among the most commonly used antibiotics in the treatment of routine infections, and their use is increasing over time, they can cause a range of hypersensitivity reactions, from mild, delayed-onset cutaneous reactions to life-threatening anaphylaxis in patients with immunoglobulin E (IgE)-mediated allergy.

cephalosporins.name: cephalosporin
cephalosporins.definition: A class of β-lactam antibiotics differing from the penicillins in having a 6-membered, rather than a 5-membered, side ring.  Although cephalosporins are among the most commonly used antibiotics in the treatment of routine infections, and their use is increasing over time, they can cause a range of hypersensitivity reactions, from mild, delayed-onset cutaneous reactions to life-threatening anaphylaxis in patients with immunoglobulin E (IgE)-mediated allergy.

azithromycin.name: azithromycin(2+)
azithromycin.definition: A tertiary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the two amino groups of azithromycin; major species at pH 7.3.

glycopeptides.name: glycopeptide
glycopeptides.definition: Any carbohydrate derivative that consists of glycan moieties covalently attached to the side chains of the amino acid residues that constitute the peptide.

macrolide.name: macrolide
macrolide.definition: A macrocyclic lactone with a ring of twelve or more members derived from a polyketide.

macrolides.name: macrolide
macrolides.definition: A macrocyclic lactone with a ring of twelve or more members derived from a polyketide.

amikacin.name: amikacin
amikacin.definition: An amino cyclitol glycoside that is kanamycin A acylated at the N-1 position by a 4-amino-2-hydroxybutyryl group.

amoxicillin.name: amoxicillin
amoxicillin.definition: A penicillin in which the substituent at position 6 of the penam ring is a 2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetamido group.

tetracyclines.name: tetracyclines
tetracyclines.definition: A subclass of polyketides having an octahydrotetracene-2-carboxamide skeleton, substituted with many hydroxy and other groups.

tetracycline.name: tetracycline
tetracycline.definition: A broad-spectrum polyketide antibiotic produced by the Streptomyces genus of actinobacteria.

vancomycin.name: vancomycin
vancomycin.definition: A complex glycopeptide from Streptomyces orientalis. It inhibits a specific step in the synthesis of the peptidoglycan layer in the Gram-positive bacteria Staphylococcus aureus and Clostridium difficile.

rifampicin.name: rifampicin
rifampicin.definition: A member of the class of rifamycins that is a a semisynthetic antibiotic derived from Amycolatopsis rifamycinica (previously known as Amycolatopsis mediterranei and Streptomyces mediterranei).

rifampin.name: rifampicin
rifampin.definition: A member of the class of rifamycins that is a a semisynthetic antibiotic derived from Amycolatopsis rifamycinica (previously known as Amycolatopsis mediterranei and Streptomyces mediterranei).

tobramycin.name: tobramycin
tobramycin.definition: A amino cyclitol glycoside that is kanamycin B lacking the 3-hydroxy substituent from the 2,6-diaminoglucose ring.

fosfomycin.name: fosfomycin
fosfomycin.definition: A phosphonic acid having an (R,S)-1,2-epoxypropyl group attached to phosphorus.

ampicillin.name: ampicillin
ampicillin.definition: A penicillin in which the substituent at position 6 of the penam ring is a 2-amino-2-phenylacetamido group.

ceftriaxone.name: ceftriaxone
ceftriaxone.definition: A third-generation cephalosporin compound having 2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetylamino and

ceftazidime.name: ceftazidime
ceftazidime.definition: A third-generation cephalosporin antibiotic bearing pyridinium-1-ylmethyl and {[(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-{[(2-carboxypropan-2-yl)oxy]imino}acetamido groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively, of the cephem skeleton.

sulfonamide.name: sulfonamide
sulfonamide.definition: An amide of a sulfonic acid RS(=O)<small><sub>2</sub></small>NR'<small><sub>2</sub></small>.

sulfonamides.name: sulfonamide
sulfonamides.definition: An amide of a sulfonic acid RS(=O)<small><sub>2</sub></small>NR'<small><sub>2</sub></small>.

beta-lactam.name: beta-lactam
beta-lactam.definition: A lactam in which the amide bond is contained within a four-membered ring, which includes the amide nitrogen and the carbonyl carbon.

beta-lactams.name: beta-lactam
beta-lactams.definition: A lactam in which the amide bond is contained within a four-membered ring, which includes the amide nitrogen and the carbonyl carbon.

clarithromycin.name: clarithromycin
clarithromycin.definition: The 6-O-methyl ether of erythromycin A, clarithromycin is a macrolide antibiotic used in the treatment of respiratory-tract, skin and soft-tissue infections. It is also used to eradicate Helicobacter pylori in the treatment of peptic ulcer disease. It prevents bacteria from growing by interfering with their protein synthesis.

co-trimoxazole.name: co-trimoxazole
co-trimoxazole.definition: A two-component mixture comprising trimethoprim and sulfamethoxazole.

cotrimoxazole.name: co-trimoxazole
cotrimoxazole.definition: A two-component mixture comprising trimethoprim and sulfamethoxazole.

colistin.name: colistin
colistin.definition: A multi-component mixture comprising mostly of colistin A (R = Me) and B (R = H), with small amounts of colistin C and other polymyxins, produced by certain strains of Bacillus polymyxa var. colistinus. An antibiotic, it is used as its sulfate salt (for oral or topical use) or as the sodium salt of the N-methylsulfonic acid derivative (the injectable form) in the treatment of severe Gram-negative infections, partiularly those due to Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

polymyxin e.name: colistin
polymyxin e.definition: A multi-component mixture comprising mostly of colistin A (R = Me) and B (R = H), with small amounts of colistin C and other polymyxins, produced by certain strains of Bacillus polymyxa var. colistinus. An antibiotic, it is used as its sulfate salt (for oral or topical use) or as the sodium salt of the N-methylsulfonic acid derivative (the injectable form) in the treatment of severe Gram-negative infections, partiularly those due to Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

ertapenem.name: ertapenem
ertapenem.definition: Meropenem in which the one of the two methyl groups attached to the amide nitrogen is replaced by hydrogen while the other is replaced by a 3-carboxyphenyl group. The sodium salt is used for the treatment of moderate to severe susceptible infections including intra-abdominal  and acute gynaecological infections, pneumonia, and infections of the skin and of the urinary tract.

erythromycin.name: erythromycin A
erythromycin.definition: An erythromycin that consists of erythronolide A having 2,6-dideoxy-3-C-methyl-3-O-methyl-α-L-ribo-hexopyranosyl and 3,4,6-trideoxy-3-(dimethylamino)-β-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl residues attahced at positions 4 and 6 respectively.

meropenem.name: meropenem
meropenem.definition: A carbapenemcarboxylic acid in which the azetidine and pyrroline rings carry 1-hydroxymethyl and in which the azetidine and pyrroline rings carry 1-hydroxymethyl and 5-(dimethylcarbamoyl)pyrrolidin-3-ylthio substituents respectively.

trimethoprim.name: trimethoprim
trimethoprim.definition: An aminopyrimidine antibiotic whose structure consists of pyrimidine 2,4-diamine and 1,2,3-trimethoxybenzene moieties linked by a methylene bridge.

carbapenems.name: carbapenems
carbapenems.definition: The class of β-lactam antibiotics that whose members have a carbapenem skeleton which is variously substituted at positions 3, 4, and 6.

carbapenem.name: carbapenem
carbapenem.definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that consists of (5R)-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]hept-2-ene bearing a 7-keto substituent. The parent of the class of carbapenems.

cefepime.name: cefepime
cefepime.definition: A cephalosporin bearing (1-methylpyrrolidinium-1-yl)methyl and (2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetamido groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively, of the cephem skeleton.

minocycline.name: minocycline
minocycline.definition: A tetracycline analogue having a dimethylamino group at position 7 and lacking the methyl and hydroxy groups at position 5.

doxycycline.name: doxycycline
doxycycline.definition: Tetracycline in which the 5β-hydrogen is replaced by a hydroxy group, while the 6α-hydroxy group is replaced by hydrogen. A semi-synthetic tetracycline antibiotic, it is used to inhibit bacterial protein synthesis and treat non-gonococcal urethritis and cervicitis, exacerbations of bronchitis in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and adult periodontitis.

polymyxin.name: polymyxin
polymyxin.definition: Polymyxins are antibiotics with a general structure consisting of a cyclic peptide with a long hydrophobic tail. They disrupt the structure of the bacterial cell membrane by interacting with its phospholipids. Polymyxins are produced by the Gram-positive bacterium Bacillus polymyxa and are selectively toxic for Gram-negative bacteria.

polymyxins.name: polymyxin
polymyxins.definition: Polymyxins are antibiotics with a general structure consisting of a cyclic peptide with a long hydrophobic tail. They disrupt the structure of the bacterial cell membrane by interacting with its phospholipids. Polymyxins are produced by the Gram-positive bacterium Bacillus polymyxa and are selectively toxic for Gram-negative bacteria.

daptomycin.name: daptomycin
daptomycin.definition: A polypeptide comprising N-decanoyltryptophan, asparagine, aspartic acid, threonine, glycine, ornithine, aspartic acid, D-alanine, aspartic acid, glycine, D-serine, threo-3-methylglutamic acid and 3-anthraniloylalanine (also known as kynurinine) coupled in sequence and lactonised by condensation of the carboxylic acid group of the 3-anthraniloylalanine with the alcohol group of the threonine residue.

isoniazid.name: isoniazide
isoniazid.definition: A carbohydrazide obtained by formal condensation between pyridine-4-carboxylic acid and hydrazine.

levofloxacin.name: levofloxacin
levofloxacin.definition: An optically active form of ofloxacin having (S)-configuration; an inhibitor of bacterial topoisomerase IV and DNA gyrase.

linezolid.name: linezolid
linezolid.definition: An organofluorine compound that consists of 1,3-oxazolidin-2-one bearing an N-3-fluoro-4-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl group as well as an acetamidomethyl group at position 5. A synthetic antibacterial agent that inhibits bacterial protein synthesis by binding to a site on 23S ribosomal RNA of the 50S subunit and prevents further formation of a functional 70S initiation complex.

moxifloxacin.name: moxifloxacin
moxifloxacin.definition: A quinolone that consists of 4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid bearing a cyclopropyl substituent at position 1, a fluoro substitiuent at position 6, a (4aS,7aS)-octahydro-6H-pyrrolo[3,4-b]pyridin-6-yl group at position 7 and a methoxy substituent at position 8. A member of the fluoroquinolone class of antibacterial agents.

methicillin.name: methicillin
methicillin.definition: A penicillin that is 6-aminopenicillanic acid in which one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by a 2,6-dimethoxybenzoyl group.

ceftaroline.name: ceftaroline
ceftaroline.definition: A cephalosporin that is the active metabolite of the prodrug ceftaroline fosamil.  Used for the treatment of adults with acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections.

nitrofurantoin.name: nitrofurantoin
nitrofurantoin.definition: An imidazolidine-2,4-dione that is hydantoin substituted at position 1 by a

oxacillin.name: oxacillin
oxacillin.definition: A penicillin antibiotic carrying a 5-methyl-3-phenylisoxazole-4-carboxamide group at position 6β.

piperacillin.name: piperacillin
piperacillin.definition: A penicillin in which the substituent at position 6 of the penam ring is a 2-[(4-ethyl-2,3-dioxopiperazin-1-yl)carboxamido]-2-phenylacetamido group.

avibactam.name: avibactam
avibactam.definition: A member of the class of azabicycloalkanes that is (2S,5R)-7-oxo-1,6-diazabicyclo[3.2.1]octane-2-carboxamide in which the amino hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a sulfooxy group. Used (in the form of its sodium salt) in combination with ceftazidime pentahydrate for the treatment of complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis.

sulfamethoxazole.name: sulfamethoxazole
sulfamethoxazole.definition: An isoxazole (1,2-oxazole) compound having a methyl substituent at the 5-position and a 4-aminobenzenesulfonamido group at the 3-position.

ticarcillin.name: ticarcillin
ticarcillin.definition: A penicillin compound having a 6β-[(2R)-2-carboxy-2-thiophen-3-ylacetyl]amino side-group.
